description:
Fix repository issues without ever leaving JetBrains IntelliJ. In this short video, learn how to install the GitHub Copilot plugin from the marketplace, find open GitHub issues, and generate step-by-step implementation plans. Watch how Copilot's coding agent implements the fix and explains the changes using ask mode.
